components.css: .ds-go { display: inline-flex; align-items: center; height: 44px; padding: 0 20px; border-radius: 8px; background: var(--fd-ink, #16181d); color: var(--fd-card, #ffffff); font: 700 15px 'Archivo', ui-sans-serif, system-ui, sans-serif; text-decoration: none; transition: transform 0.2s cubic-bezier(0.16, 1, 0.3, 1); } .ds-go:hover { transform: translateY(-1px); } .ds-go:focus-visible { outline: 2px solid #2f5bff; outline-offset: 2px; }

components.css: .ds-cmd { width: 300px; height: 44px; padding: 0 8px 0 14px; display: flex; align-items: center; justify-content: space-between; gap: 8px; border: 1.5px solid var(--fd-ink, #16181d); border-radius: 8px; background: var(--fd-card, #fff); color: var(--fd-ink, #16181d); cursor: copy; } .ds-cmd code { font: 500 14px 'JetBrains Mono', ui-monospace, monospace; } .ds-copy { display: grid; place-items: center; width: 30px; height: 30px; border-radius: 6px; background: var(--fd-ground, #f4f5f7); } .ds-copy svg { width: 16px; height: 16px; fill: none; stroke: currentColor; stroke-width: 2; stroke-linecap: round; stroke-linejoin: round; } .ds-cmd:focus-visible { outline: 2px solid #2f5bff; outline-offset: 2px; }

components.name: Fan Strip
components.description: Signature: a paint-deck strip with a named tab and full-strength swatches; selected slides out with an ink dot.
components.css: .ds-strip { --lift: 0px; width: 104px; height: 300px; padding: 0; border: 0; display: flex; flex-direction: column; background: var(--fd-card, #fff); color: var(--fd-ink, #16181d); border-radius: 10px; overflow: hidden; text-align: left; cursor: pointer; box-shadow: 0 2px 3px rgb(22 24 29 / 0.12), 0 8px 24px rgb(22 24 29 / 0.1); transform: translateY(var(--lift)); transition: transform 0.7s cubic-bezier(0.16, 1, 0.3, 1), box-shadow 0.3s ease; } .ds-strip:hover { --lift: -8px; box-shadow: 0 4px 8px rgb(22 24 29 / 0.16), 0 30px 60px -10px rgb(22 24 29 / 0.28); } .ds-strip.is-out { --lift: -12px; box-shadow: 0 4px 8px rgb(22 24 29 / 0.16), 0 30px 60px -10px rgb(22 24 29 / 0.28); } .ds-strip:focus-visible { outline: 3px solid #16181d; outline-offset: 3px; } .ds-tab { position: relative; flex: none; height: 66px; padding: 12px 10px 0; display: flex; flex-direction: column; gap: 3px; } .ds-tab b { font: 800 14px/1.1 'Archivo', sans-serif; font-stretch: 76%; letter-spacing: 0.01em; text-transform: uppercase; } .ds-tab span { font: 500 11px/1.2 'JetBrains Mono', monospace; color: var(--fd-ink-3, #5d6270); } .ds-strip.is-out .ds-tab::after { content: ''; position: absolute; right: 10px; top: 12px; width: 12px; height: 12px; border-radius: 50%; background: #16181d; } .ds-chip { flex: 1; position: relative; } .ds-chip i { position: absolute; left: 9px; bottom: 6px; font: normal 600 11px 'JetBrains Mono', monospace; } @media (prefers-reduced-motion: reduce) { .ds-strip { transition: none; } }

components.css: .ds-frame { width: 420px; border: 1px solid var(--fd-rule-strong, #cfd2d8); border-radius: 12px; overflow: hidden; background: var(--fd-card, #fff); box-shadow: 0 2px 3px rgb(22 24 29 / 0.12), 0 8px 24px rgb(22 24 29 / 0.1); } .ds-frame-body { height: 160px; display: grid; place-items: center; font: 500 14px 'Archivo', sans-serif; color: var(--fd-ink-3, #5d6270); } .ds-frame-bar { display: flex; align-items: center; gap: 12px; padding: 8px 10px 8px 14px; border-top: 1px solid var(--fd-rule, #e4e5e8); background: var(--fd-ground, #f4f5f7); font: 500 12px/1.4 'JetBrains Mono', monospace; color: var(--fd-ink-3, #5d6270); } .ds-note { text-transform: uppercase; letter-spacing: 0.05em; } .ds-event { flex: 1; color: var(--fd-ink-2, #3a3e48); } .ds-play { padding: 6px 10px; border: 1px solid var(--fd-rule-strong, #cfd2d8); border-radius: 6px; background: var(--fd-card, #fff); color: var(--fd-ink, #16181d); font: 600 12px 'Archivo', sans-serif; cursor: pointer; } .ds-play:hover { border-color: var(--fd-ink-3, #5d6270); } .ds-play:focus-visible { outline: 2px solid #2f5bff; outline-offset: 2px; }

components.css: .ds-swatches { display: grid; grid-template-columns: repeat(3, 32px); gap: 6px; padding: 8px; background: var(--fd-ground, #f4f5f7); } .ds-sw { aspect-ratio: 1; border: 0; border-radius: 4px; cursor: pointer; transition: transform 0.15s cubic-bezier(0.16, 1, 0.3, 1); } .ds-sw:hover { transform: translateY(-2px); } .ds-sw.is-on { box-shadow: 0 0 0 2px var(--fd-ground, #f4f5f7), 0 0 0 4px var(--fd-ink, #16181d); } .ds-sw:focus-visible { outline: 2px solid #2f5bff; outline-offset: 2px; }

narrative.overview:
The site is a paint-store colour standard fanned open. One steel rivet (the one `<ai-chat>` tag) holds every strip: each strip is a framework or a model, and each carries a real, valid `<ai-chat>` theme. Turning the fan swings a strip to centre and re-themes the live chat through its actual CSS variables. Nothing on the home page is a picture of the product; the pulled card is the product.

The world is bright and dry: white chip card stock on a cool pale ground, flat full-strength swatches, ink type, one drawn steel disc. Colour is the content (it is what a fan deck is for), so the interface itself never spends hue on state. Selection, current page and hover are told by form: a strip slides out, a square notch sits beside the current link, a 2px ink underline marks the current section. The docs pages carry the same language quietly: each docs section owns one chip colour, shown as a swatch on its sidebar group and a cap-height chip on its nav link, and everything else is ink on white at a calm reading measure.

Density is low on the home page (exactly one screen on desktop, no footer) and editorial in the docs (64ch measure, generous heading space). Dark mode follows the visitor's system: page and live chat go dark, but the fan's strips keep light card stock, like a paint deck lying on a dark desk.
keyCharacteristics: Cool pale ground (#f4f5f7), never cream; white cards; ink (#16181d) type.
Five section chips, flat and full strength, one per docs section.
Archivo on its width axis for everything readable; JetBrains Mono only for code and chip codes.
One steel rivet as the mark, in the nav and at the fan's pivot; it never moves.
Code is always a dark slab, in both modes.
Live, mock-transport `<ai-chat>` instances wherever the product is shown.

rules.name: The Hue Is Content Rule
rules.body: Hue belongs to chips and themes. No selected, current, hover or active state is ever expressed by changing a colour; it is expressed by lift, notch, underline, ring or dot in ink.

rules.name: The One Chip Per Section Rule
rules.body: Each docs section owns exactly one chip colour, used only as that section's swatch (nav chip, sidebar group swatch, current-page notch). Never as text colour, background wash or button fill.

rules.name: The Never Cream Rule
rules.body: The ground is cool (#f4f5f7). Warm off-whites are outside this world.

rules.name: The Mono Is Code Rule
rules.body: JetBrains Mono appears only on code, CSS variable names, and paint/chip codes. Never for headings, buttons or prose.

rules.name: The Whole Identifier Rule
rules.body: Inline code and table identifiers never break mid-name (`white-space: nowrap`); only long values (types, defaults, payloads) may wrap.

rules.name: The Lift Is State Rule
rules.body: A strip rises 8px on hover and 12px when selected, gaining Lift High. Rising is how the deck says "this one", never a colour change.

dos: **Do** show state by form: lift (8px hover, 12px selected), a square notch, a 2px ink underline, a ring (`0 0 0 2px ground, 0 0 0 4px ink`) or a dot.
**Do** give each docs section one chip colour and use it only as that section's swatch.
**Do** put code on the dark slab (#16181d light, #0c0d10 dark) with github-dark colours in both modes.
**Do** show the product as a live `<ai-chat>` on a mock transport, framed in a 12px demo frame with Lift.
**Do** keep the home page one screen on desktop and stack label, strip row, chat on a phone.
**Do** keep prose at 64ch and stack tables into labelled cards at 768px and below.
**Do** honour `prefers-reduced-motion` on every transition and the pulsing dot.
donts: **Don't** change a colour to mark selected, current, hover or active.
**Don't** use a warm or cream ground.
**Don't** set headings, buttons or prose in JetBrains Mono.
**Don't** add a second mark or move the rivet; it is the logo in the nav and the pivot of the fan.
**Don't** put a light-themed code block on the page; light syntax colours on the dark slab are unreadable.
**Don't** let a section chip become a text colour, a background wash or a button fill.
